entries.change: Added petrol and CNG prices for Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, Kolkata and Ahmedabad, each CNG price from the city's gas distributor, so these cities can now be chosen. Bengaluru and Chennai have verified petrol prices, but their CNG prices are still to be verified, so they are not offered yet. Electricity tariffs for these states are not in the tools yet: the solar, AC and scooter tools ask for your price per unit there.

Added purchase incentives for electric two-wheelers: the central PM E-DRIVE incentive (₹2,500 a kWh up to ₹5,000, to 31 March 2028, Gazette S.O. 4424(E) of 10 August 2026) and Delhi's EV Policy 2026 (₹10,000 a kWh up to ₹30,000 in its first year, a ₹10,000 scrapping bonus and a full road-tax waiver, Delhi Gazette of 30 June 2026). For the coming e-scooter tool.

Set rooftop solar panel degradation to 0.77% a year, the steady rate matching a Tata Power Solar module's warranty floor (83.1% at year 25), and Delhi's generation-based incentive to 5 years from installation (Delhi Solar Policy 2024). Delhi's export credit is still to be verified, so it counts as nil.

Added income-tax deduction limits (80C, 80CCD(1B), 80D, home-loan interest, 80TTA, employer NPS) from the Income Tax Department's e-filing portal, and the house rent allowance rule with the eight 50% cities from tax year 2026-27, for the tax regime tool.

Added Delhi: petrol ₹102.12 a litre (26 Oct 2026) and CNG ₹86.98 a kg (IGL, from 29 Aug 2026); the DERC domestic tariff with surcharges, electricity tax and the Delhi Government's subsidy; and Delhi rooftop solar subsidies, generation-based incentive and output, from Tata Power-DDL's FY26 customer handbook. PPAC, the solar export rate, panel degradation and how long the generation incentive is paid are still to be verified.
Added the PPF rate (7.1%), deposit limits and term from the National Savings Institute, and the one-year holding period for equity, for the SIP vs PPF vs FD tool.
Added capital-gains rates (12.5% long-term, ₹1.25 lakh yearly exemption on equity gains, 20% short-term on equity) from PIB and CBDT, for the plot vs FD vs mutual funds tool.
Added income-tax slabs, standard deduction, rebate and cess for tax year 2026-27 (both regimes, under 60), from the Income Tax Department and CBDT, for the tax regime tool.
Set Lucknow CNG to ₹107.00 a kg (Green Gas Limited, from 3 Oct 2026) and Lucknow petrol to ₹101.86 a litre (19 Oct 2026).
Added UP stamp duty and registration for the rent vs buy tool, as a placeholder (not verified).
Added the UP domestic electricity tariff and rooftop solar subsidy, generation, degradation and export credit, as placeholders (not verified).
Set the default scenario table (inflation, equity return, home prices, rent, fuel and electricity prices) and the 9% default rate on the extra car price, as CapitalVerdict's working assumptions.
